purpose: Read-only cross-region scene localization and resource-path handoff for Magius3Dviewer-JP

sources.steamDecodedResourceRoot: D:\magia\Madoka Magica Magia Exedra Steam JP

joinRules: Use dioramaBackgroundMstId as the cross-language identity and backgroundResourceName as the scene-resource identity.
For gallery/battle scene labels, prefer getDioramaBackgroundMstList.stageName; QuestStage.name is a quest label and can be reused across one scene.
Convert bg_3d_600_00_01_001 to viewer id battle-600-00-01-001 only as a filename/UI identity, not as a localization key.
Direct battle bundles normally resolve to AssetBundles/battle/stage/<backgroundResourceName>. Tower stagePrefabName bg_3d_636_00_02_NNN resolves through battle/stage/tower_data/636/636_NNN.
The directory name steam-ja-Jpan is the JP catalog namespace; its snapshot locale is en-Latn and its payload is English.
TW snapshot tableLanguage is a transport field; app-mme.so-net.tw payload strings are official Traditional Chinese.
Missing locale rows mean the region has not published that scene. Keep the slot null; do not translate or infer it.
